aliasDecisions.rationale: Treat the canonically equivalent letter and compatibility unit sign as glyph variants while literal lookup stays exact.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \AA to U+00C5 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER A WITH RING ABOVE and U+212B ANGSTROM SIGN.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Treat the canonically equivalent Greek letter and compatibility ohm sign as glyph variants.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \Omega to U+03A9 GREEK CAPITAL LETTER OMEGA and U+2126 OHM SIGN.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Preserve generic capital-upsilon input across the letter and hook-shaped symbol variants.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \Upsilon to U+03A5 GREEK CAPITAL LETTER UPSILON and U+03D2 GREEK UPSILON WITH HOOK SYMBOL.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Keep the mathematical operator mapping and prevent command lookup from rewriting to ASCII punctuation.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \ast to U+002A ASTERISK and U+2217 ASTERISK OPERATOR.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Use the logical NAND relation rather than the unrelated technical projective glyph.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \barwedge to U+22BC NAND and U+2305 PROJECTIVE.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Retain the explicitly large circle scalar for the size-bearing command.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \bigcirc to U+25CB WHITE CIRCLE and U+25EF LARGE CIRCLE.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Use the standard triangle rather than the distinct small-size scalar.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \blacktriangleleft to U+25C0 BLACK LEFT-POINTING TRIANGLE and U+25C2 BLACK LEFT-POINTING SMALL TRIANGLE.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Use the standard triangle rather than the distinct small-size scalar.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \blacktriangleright to U+25B6 BLACK RIGHT-POINTING TRIANGLE and U+25B8 BLACK RIGHT-POINTING SMALL TRIANGLE.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Use the explicitly mathematical bullet operator rather than prose-list punctuation.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \bullet to U+2022 BULLET and U+2219 BULLET OPERATOR.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Treat the commonly extracted middle dot and dedicated dot operator as mathematical glyph variants.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \cdot to U+00B7 MIDDLE DOT and U+22C5 DOT OPERATOR.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Preserve an established Placekeeper search input without changing standards-derived admission.
aliasDecisions.upstream: Placekeeper 0.x manual symbol catalog compatibility input.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Use the mathematical rising diagonal rather than a box-drawing character.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \diagup to U+2571 BOX DRAWINGS LIGHT DIAGONAL UPPER RIGHT TO LOWER LEFT and U+27CB MATHEMATICAL RISING DIAGONAL.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Use the mathematical diamond operator rather than the playing-card suit.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \diamond to U+22C4 DIAMOND OPERATOR and U+2662 WHITE DIAMOND SUIT.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Treat the established not-greater-or-equal forms as relation glyph variants.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \gneq to U+2269 NOT GREATER-THAN BUT EQUAL TO and U+2A88 GREATER-THAN AND SINGLE-LINE NOT EQUAL TO.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Treat the standardized greater/equal/less constructions as relation variants.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \gtreqqless to U+22DB GREATER-THAN EQUAL TO OR LESS-THAN and U+2A8C GREATER-THAN ABOVE DOUBLE-LINE EQUAL ABOVE LESS-THAN.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Keep the unstyled dotless-i command separate from its mathematical italic presentation scalar.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \imath to U+0131 LATIN SMALL LETTER DOTLESS I and U+1D6A4 MATHEMATICAL ITALIC SMALL DOTLESS I.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Drop anomalous styled-epsilon mappings so the membership command resolves only to element-of.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \in to U+2208 ELEMENT OF and styled epsilon scalars U+1D716, U+1D750, and U+1D7C4.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Treat the standardized less/equal/greater constructions as relation variants.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \lesseqqgtr to U+22DA LESS-THAN EQUAL TO OR GREATER-THAN and U+2A8B LESS-THAN ABOVE DOUBLE-LINE EQUAL ABOVE GREATER-THAN.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Treat the established not-less-or-equal forms as relation glyph variants.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \lneq to U+2268 LESS-THAN BUT NOT EQUAL TO and U+2A87 LESS-THAN AND SINGLE-LINE NOT EQUAL TO.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Preserve an established Placekeeper search input without changing standards-derived admission.
aliasDecisions.upstream: Placekeeper 0.x manual symbol catalog compatibility input.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Keep the generic command on the base operator and styled partial scalars distinct.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \partial to U+2202 PARTIAL DIFFERENTIAL and five mathematical styled partial-differential scalars.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Use the dedicated perpendicular relation rather than the general up-tack glyph.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \perp to U+22A5 UP TACK and U+27C2 PERPENDICULAR.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Preserve generic phi input across the two Unicode phi variants.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \varphi to U+03C6 and \phi to U+03D5; Placekeeper historically accepted \phi for both variants.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Treat the standardized preceding-or-approximate forms as relation variants.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \precapprox to U+227E PRECEDES OR EQUIVALENT TO and U+2AB7 PRECEDES ABOVE ALMOST EQUAL TO.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Resolve the directional command to the right-facing crescent and leave the opposite crescent exact-only.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \rightmoon to U+263D FIRST QUARTER MOON and U+263E LAST QUARTER MOON.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Treat the single-line and double-line subset-or-equal forms as relation variants.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \subseteqq to U+2286 SUBSET OF OR EQUAL TO and U+2AC5 SUBSET OF ABOVE EQUALS SIGN.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Treat the single-line and double-line non-equal subset forms as relation variants.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \subsetneqq to U+228A SUBSET OF WITH NOT EQUAL TO and U+2ACB SUBSET OF ABOVE NOT EQUAL TO.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Treat the standardized succeeding-or-approximate forms as relation variants.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \succapprox to U+227F SUCCEEDS OR EQUIVALENT TO and U+2AB8 SUCCEEDS ABOVE ALMOST EQUAL TO.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Treat the standardized succeeds-or-equal forms as relation variants.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \succeq to U+227D SUCCEEDS OR EQUAL TO and U+2AB0 SUCCEEDS ABOVE SINGLE-LINE EQUALS SIGN.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Treat the standardized succeeds-but-not-approximate forms as relation variants.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \succnapprox to U+22E9 SUCCEEDS BUT NOT EQUIVALENT TO and U+2ABA SUCCEEDS ABOVE NOT ALMOST EQUAL TO.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Treat the single-line and double-line superset-or-equal forms as relation variants.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \supseteqq to U+2287 SUPERSET OF OR EQUAL TO and U+2AC6 SUPERSET OF ABOVE EQUALS SIGN.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Treat the single-line and double-line non-equal superset forms as relation variants.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \supsetneqq to U+228B SUPERSET OF WITH NOT EQUAL TO and U+2ACC SUPERSET OF ABOVE NOT EQUAL TO.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Use the standard triangle rather than the distinct small-size scalar.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns \triangleright to U+25B7 WHITE RIGHT-POINTING TRIANGLE and U+25B9 WHITE RIGHT-POINTING SMALL TRIANGLE.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Reject an accent command that requires an argument rather than treating it as a one-symbol command.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns bare \u to U+02D8 BREVE and U+0306 COMBINING BREVE although TeX uses it with an argument.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Correct the generic TeX variant-epsilon command to the Greek mathematical symbol while leaving the IPA letter exact-only.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C unicode.xml assigns \varepsilon to U+025B LATIN SMALL LETTER OPEN E; UnicodeData identifies U+03F5 as GREEK LUNATE EPSILON SYMBOL.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Keep the conventional entity on much-greater-than rather than the distinct nested relation.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns Gt to U+226B MUCH GREATER-THAN and U+2AA2 DOUBLE NESTED GREATER-THAN.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Keep the conventional entity on much-less-than rather than the distinct nested relation.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns Lt to U+226A MUCH LESS-THAN and U+2AA1 DOUBLE NESTED LESS-THAN.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Use the open-box blank marker and keep the distinct blank-symbol glyph exact-only.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns blank to U+2422 BLANK SYMBOL and U+2423 OPEN BOX.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Follow the entity's down-then-right mnemonic rather than the unrelated arc arrow.
aliasDecisions.upstream: W3C assigns cudarrr to U+2935 ARROW POINTING RIGHTWARDS THEN CURVING DOWNWARDS and U+2939 LEFT-SIDE ARC CLOCKWISE ARROW.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Keep the legacy entity on the base f-with-hook scalar and preserve styled f as distinct.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Follow the left-arrow-plus mnemonic rather than the unrelated arc arrow.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Use the mathematical asterisk operator and keep prose punctuation distinct.

aliasDecisions.rationale: Keep the conventional open-circle arrow entity separate from the technical closed-circle arrow.
